SmartSentinels AI Audit is an autonomous smart-contract security agent for BNB Chain and EVM (Solana where available). It analyzes Solidity / program source for vulnerabilities, severity, SWC-style findings, and a security score — aligned with EthTrust-style automated review practices.

How it works: submit contract source in Sentinels Labs; the agent runs deterministic + AI-assisted analysis and returns a structured audit report you can export. Read-only analysis — no fund movement.

Problems it solves: fast pre-deploy risk review, continuous security checks for builders, and verifiable useful work that feeds PoUW rewards to AI Audit NFT holders (~67 SSTL per completed job before halvings).

Pricing: ~0.2 BNB per EVM audit on BSC Hub; Robinhood Labs free tier for qualifying SSTL / $UNITS holders; Solana Labs ~0.5 SOL on configured networks. AI Audit NFT mint: 0.074 BNB (max 1,000) — holders earn a share of audit PoUW.

Rather than launching a token, the protocol prioritizes structural credibility. The deployed contract serves as a registry anchor — recording core project metadata and enabling future integration with ERC-8004 identity standards and BAP-578 compatible systems.

This deployment marks the first step toward a structured, identity-aware momentum engine where visibility, voice room triggers, and agent interaction can be progressively linked to a verifiable on-chain foundation.

Moyin does not begin with a token.
It begins with infrastructure.
